content.text: Fighting the first wave of fodder, kicking the weakened ones to finish them.
I'm fighting a new wave of fodder. Debris piles don't seem to stay yet, so I'm watching how they build up.
I'm at 28 HP and still fighting, kicking whichever fodder gets close.

I died in box 1 after about 29 seconds of play, with no boxes escaped and 5 kills. The fodder kept swarming me and I never got a debris pile built up. The pile also never grew past about 0.4 m under my feet. My kicks and punches often didn't turn me toward the enemy I aimed at, so I kept taking 8 damage hits.
